articles.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
articles.summary: As stocks continue their tech-driven sell-off, prediction markets traders are seeing a bleaker outlook for the remainder of the year. On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite turned negative for the year as investors continued to dump tech stocks, primarily those with exposure to the artificial intelligence build-out. The Stock Trader's Almanac in a Thursday note broadly agreed that the hopes for a December rally are fading, with the caveat that a "Santa rally" could still appear at the end of the year.

articles.title: Jensen Huang to testify publicly before Senate banking panel, Chairman Scott says
articles.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will testify publicly when he appears before the Senate banking panel, a spokesperson for Committee Chair Tim Scott said Friday. The South Carolina Republican confirmed earlier this week that Huang had agreed to appear, but the details of that appearance remained unclear.
